title: LedgerLens staging deployment status
description: Machine-readable record of the continuously deployed staging instance. Written by scripts/staging-upgrade.sh and published by .github/workflows/staging-deploy.yml. See docs/staging-deployment.md.

network.description: Staging network alias. Staging CD never targets mainnet.

contract_id.description: Staging contract instance upgraded in place.

wasm_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the currently deployed staging WASM artifact.

previous_wasm_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the last known-good WASM used for automatic rollback.

version.description: On-chain contract version reported by get_version after deploy.

schema_version.description: Contract schema version this status file was validated against.

status.description: Last deployment outcome. proposed-pending means the upgrade proposal is recorded and awaiting the time-lock window.

health.description: Result of scripts/health_check.sh against the staging instance.

commit_sha.description: Main-branch commit the staging artifact was built from.

workflow_run_url.description: Link to the GitHub Actions run that produced this status.

last_deploy_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the last status update.
